instructions: Create SQLite tables: expenses(id, amount, category, description, date) and budget(id, daily_limit). Implement DAO functions for creating, listing (with optional start_date/end_date filters), deleting expenses, and getting/setting budget.

Add route GET /api/stats that computes total spent today, remaining budget today (daily_limit - total_today), total spent this month, and sum of amounts grouped by category. Returns JSON with those fields.

Initialize Vite + React + TypeScript project. Create a singleton service (expenseApi.ts) wrapping fetch calls to the backend endpoints (list, create, delete, get/set budget, stats). Include basic error handling and TypeScript types matching API schemas.

Component shows a table/list of expenses fetched on mount via listExpenses (optionally filtered by date). Includes a form to submit new expense (amount, category, date, description). On submit calls createExpense and refreshes list. Each row displays a delete button calling deleteExpense. Shows loading/error states.
Component fetches current budget via getBudget on mount. Shows input field to set new budget; on submit calls setBudget and updates displayed limit. Includes validation (positive number).
Component calls getStats on mount and displays: total spent today, remaining budget today, total spent this month, and a bar chart (or list) of spending by category. Handles loading and error states.
